title: Chapter 270: Anything Can Be Solved with a Swing of the Hammer
html:
The sight of Chen Ge in the doctor’s costume made Gu Feiyu step back instinctively. Recovering a moment later, he answered, “Yes. All three students gave the Haunted House five stars while I watched. They said they had a wonderful time and hoped you wouldn’t be too hard on that actor.”

“They had a wonderful time?” Chen Ge nodded. “Good. As long as they enjoyed themselves.”

“Brother Chen, what happened to those two visitors? They’re both unconscious. Are they truly all right?” After some hesitation, Gu Feiyu added, “And what did the students mean about a Haunted House employee?”

“Nothing important. If you want to work here, Xiao Gu, you’ll need to grow accustomed to such things. You should also learn first aid.” Chen Ge had him carry Wei Wu while he took Kong Xiangming. “For now, we’ll lock them in the dressing room.”

“First aid? Lock them in the dressing room?” Cold sweat covered Gu Feiyu’s forehead. Somehow, he felt that he had walked into a trap.

“They aren’t visitors.” Realizing Xiao Gu’s misunderstanding, Chen Ge offered a simple explanation. “New Century Park is recovering, largely because of the Haunted House’s promotion. Certain people dislike our comeback and sent these men to sabotage us.”

“Oh, I see.” Xiao Gu nodded solemnly. “Life in the big city really is complicated.”

Xiao Gu carried Wei Wu while Chen Ge dragged Kong Xiangming. They stopped outside the Sealed Classroom. “Two visitors remain underground. They should be in the scenario to the right. Wait here. I’ll return shortly.”

Chen Ge left Kong Xiangming there and hurried into the girls’ dormitory. Alone outside the classroom, Gu Feiyu felt someone watching him from within.

“Brother Chen, wait! I’m coming with you!” They had barely entered the right-hand corridor when an argument reached them. Na Na’s temper still raged, and she remained determined to end the relationship. Her fury had extinguished every trace of fear.

What are these two doing? Fighting inside a Haunted House?

The visitors stood in the corridor, far from any active scares. So absorbed were they in their quarrel that neither seemed likely to stop soon.

“Brother Chen, please slow down.” Gu Feiyu half carried, half dragged the two Ghost Stories Society members behind him.

“Why did you follow me?”

“I was worried, so I came to help.” Gu Feiyu looked ahead and changed the subject. “They’re having a serious argument. Should we intervene?”

“Do you know them? How exactly would we help?” Chen Ge swung the hammer. Dealing with hostile ghosts was easier; at least a hammer could solve those problems.

“But letting them argue like this cannot be good. We’re inside the Haunted House. If word spreads, it could damage our reputation.” Gu Feiyu stood behind Chen Ge, uncomfortable with eavesdropping on a couple’s private quarrel.

“If they truly wanted to separate, the argument wouldn’t have lasted half an hour.” Chen Ge put on the skin mask, raised the hammer, and approached the couple.

Before he reached them, Na Na shoved the man back, slipped into the Pen Spirit’s bedroom, and locked the door. Her companion pounded on it while she wept inside and refused to answer.

“Yan Na Na!” The woman had secured both door and windows. The man called her name from outside, but she remained determined to end their relationship.

“Chen Ziming, we met in a Haunted House, so let’s end it here too. Two years, six months, and one day—thank you for everything.”

“I don’t understand why you’re leaving me! Haven’t I treated you well?”

“You’re very good; it’s all my fault. Are you satisfied?”

The endless argument grated on Chen Ge. Dragging the hammer across the floor, he quickened his steps until they echoed down the corridor. Chen Ziming noticed him and felt a flicker of fear, but anger immediately smothered it. He turned, ready to unleash his frustration on the intruder.

He pointed at Chen Ge and opened his mouth, but before a sound emerged, Chen Ge charged and swung the hammer into the door’s lock.

The wooden door splintered, and the lock struck the opposite wall with a sharp crack.

The couple froze, especially Chen Ziming. He had heard the hammer slice through the air. His mouth remained open as he stared at the skin mask, eyes twitching, while his body ignored every command to move.

Na Na stopped crying and began to scream.

Chen Ziming tried to enter the bedroom, but his legs refused to move. His ears rang. After staggering backward, his body pitched forward.

“Ziming!” Na Na caught his shoulders and placed herself between him and Chen Ge.

Chen Ge pulled the hammer from the ruined door, slightly embarrassed. He had used the weapon so often lately that he had forgotten how to moderate his strength.

He coughed awkwardly and removed the skin mask. Before shock gave way to fury, he said, “When danger appeared, your partner’s first instinct wasn’t to flee but to enter the room and protect you. That proves how deeply he cares.”

He turned to the fallen man. “When you collapsed, your partner forgot everything else and rushed to shield you. If you lose a woman that devoted, you’ll regret it for the rest of your life.”

His bloodstained coat stirring in the draft, Chen Ge smiled and helped them stand.

“You love each other. Whatever else happens, that is what matters.” Chen Ge set the hammer aside. “If you doubt me, we can perform a small test.”

Chen Ge seated the visitors on opposite sides of a chair. Their fingers intertwined around a ballpoint pen wrapped in clear tape.

“This Haunted House has operated for years, and certain objects have developed spirits. This pen is one of them. Ask the question buried in your heart, and it will answer.”

The couple slowly recovered from Chen Ge’s shock. Looking into each other’s eyes, each felt the warmth of the other’s palm. At last they began the Pen Spirit game. “Pen Spirit, Pen Spirit, you were my spirit in a previous life, and I am your spirit in this one. Does my partner love me more than anyone else in the world?”

Chen Ge looked away and rolled his eyes while repeatedly signaling the Pen Spirit. He needed the couple out as soon as possible. Several seconds later, the pen moved, and each visitor saw surprise in the other’s eyes.

Across the paper, the pen wrote a single word. “Yes.”

Once they dismissed the Pen Spirit, the game ended and the couple released the pen.

“Ziming…” Na Na whispered an apology, and he drew her into an embrace.

“I’ll make more time to accompany you in the future!”

“I should have been more understanding.”

“It’s okay, honey.”

“Are you finished?” Veins stood out across the hand gripping Chen Ge’s hammer. His patience was nearing its limit.

“Boss, we’re sorry for causing so much trouble.” The couple finally separated and showered Chen Ge with apologies and thanks.

“If you hadn’t met in my Haunted House, I wouldn’t have interfered.” Chen Ge put away the hammer. “Good luck together. Don’t leave yourselves regrets.”

“We won’t!”

After escorting the couple away, Xiao Gu remained astonished. When Chen Ge destroyed the door, he had prepared to call the police. This conclusion was the last thing he had expected.

“Brother Chen, you’re amazing.”

“Stop dawdling. Bring the toolbox from upstairs. We need to repair this door.”
